Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for late-October 2024

Body.Content:
In late-October 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • More than twice as many Azure regions as before now support autoscaling—up to 80 vCores—using serverless in Azure SQL Database.
